div.div: عُصَافَةٌ What has fallen from the ears of corn, [app. when they are trodden, or thrashed, consisting] of the straw, (S, O, K, [but in the CK التنِّيْن is put in the place of التِّبْن,]) and the like. (S.) See also عَصْفٌ. Also What the wind has carried away. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
